name: 46383 · Valparaiso, IN
findings: ZIP 46383 (Valparaiso) has 218 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46383 (Valparaiso) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46383 (Valparaiso) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 71 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
